subject: SOC2 re-attest: archival handoff, log horizon uplift & renewal terms
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@capellahealth.com>

Cc: Evan Cho <evan.cho@capellahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 2 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 re-attestation & log retention for renewal

Vanessa —

We're kicking off our renewal / re-attestation for SOC 2 and the audit firm asked for a revised evidence plan. A couple of asks from our side:

- We need a retained copy of operational logs (API request/response metadata + audit trails) at a 3-year horizon for a subset of systems that interact with PHI for the period of the next contract term. Your standard retention is 90 days; we need an uplift.
- Can Redwood provide an encrypted, append-only snapshot (S3 or similar) we can export to our archive provider? If so, what format and how long will the transfer window be?
- We'll likely need 48-72 hours of burst capacity to upload historical evidence (approx 1.2 TB). Can you confirm availability and any uplift pricing?
- Procurement will need an amendment template to sign — prefer a simple addendum that includes the retention horizon and storage fee.

Can you point us to a timeline and the artifacts you need from our side? We want to lock this before the renewal kick-off on May 20.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Head of Security Operations
Capella Health

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>

Hi Maya,

Thanks — we're aligned on priorities and can support a path that accommodates both the audit and a renewal amendment. High-level proposal below; attaching our evidence manifest template and a first-pass archival addendum (draft).

Options for log horizon uplift (per scope):
- Option A — 12 months retained (default uplift): no infra change, $0.03/GB/month for archived storage.
- Option B — 36 months retained (recommended for your auditors): requires snapshot archival and retention tags; $0.05/GB/month plus a one-time ingestion/transfer fee for historical uploads.

Evidence transfer / snapshot details:
- We can produce encrypted S3-compatible snapshots (gzipped JSONL of audit rows + metadata manifest).
- Transfer window: we can provision a dedicated burst bucket for a 72-hour upload window. We recommend scheduling on a weekend to avoid impact to live traffic.
- For the 1.2 TB estimate you gave, transfer throughput on the burst plan should complete within the 48–72 hour range depending on your egress. We'll provide presigned S3 URLs and a short runbook.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm you want Option B (36 months) — we'll provision the archival bucket and estimate the ingestion fee.
2) Procurement: I'll send an addendum draft via DocuSign once you confirm Option B.
3) Technical kickoff: Karthik or Ben will run a 30-min handoff to walk your infra team through presigned URL upload.

Attachments: evidence_manifest_template.csv, archival_addendum_draft.pdf

If that sounds right, confirm and we'll lock dates for the weekend of May 20.

Best,

Vanessa / Maya —

Technical notes to make the handoff smooth:

- Artifact format: we will emit audit rows as newline-delimited JSON (JSONL), compressed with gzip. Each row includes timestamp (RFC3339), request_id, redaction_flag, user_id_hash, endpoint, status_code, and event_type. We will NOT include raw PII; if you need tokenized or redacted payloads, we can include a redaction flag and a separate redacted_payload reference.
- Retention enforcement: we will implement retention tags at object-level and enforce TTL via lifecycle rules in the archival bucket. For 36-months, we add a lifecycle rule to prevent deletion before 36 months (governed by the addendum).
- Transfer mechanism: presigned PUT URLs + multipart upload recommended for large bundles. We'll give one-time presigned credentials scoped to the upload prefix.
- Proof of delivery: once upload completes, we'll run a checksum pass and produce an evidence_manifest.csv (schema attached) and an upload_report.json (signed metadata).

Operational items for Capella:
- Confirm S3-compatible endpoint and any egress limits.
- Confirm whether uploads must go through your on-prem proxy (we've seen throughput drops when proxy is in-chain).

I'm available for the technical handoff May 18–19.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Pricing summary (est):

- Monthly storage for archival: est $0.05/GB/month. Based on steady-state 40 GB/month, initial monthly billing (month 1 after uplift) ≈ $2.00 for new monthly delta; archival bucket charges for historical 1.2 TB start pro-rated.
- Temporary burst capacity: included in the ingestion fee for a single 72-hour window. Additional windows bill at $250/window.

Technical & compliance bullets:
- Server-side redaction: we support server-side redaction during ingest for structured fields. We'll produce a redaction_manifest.csv mapping record_id -> redaction_reason/hash. If you prefer pre-redaction, we can accept either.
- Evidence outputs: evidence_manifest_template.csv (attached) + a signed upload_report.json and checksum report.
- Amendment clause: retention period = 36 months; Redwood will apply immutable lifecycle rules and provide proof-of-preservation reports on request during audits. Addendum draft attached.

Procurement flow:
1) I'll send the addendum via DocuSign (signable).
2) Capella issues PO referencing RDW-DEAL-8921 and the addendum.
3) Redwood invoices against PO after DocuSign completion.

Attachments: archival_addendum_draft.pdf, handoff_instructions_v1.md
